notes.title: Update 1.32 Analysis Board Rework
notes.notes: [p]As many use this feature, I decided to postpone working on Alekhine's games and instead spend a week upgrading the Analysis Board. The old code bad to say the least, so I basically redesigned everything from scratch. I made a new UI entirely:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964536/2007976b2a591e6d023c6847e5b8b73c0a415cd9.png"][/img][/p][p][b][u]New features:[/u][/b][/p][p][b][u]Multiple engine lines are now Supported:[/u][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964536/d0b9bada37b04a4ea3421edee71f332b379a6198.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Edit:[/p][p]As of now, Stockfish 17.1 is now bundled Chess Tools. I previously didn't do it for legal reasons because you need to make your source code public under their license. However if you simply link the exe externally and don't modify the code, you can simply link to where to get Stockfish and not have to make your whole game source code open source.[/p][p]So in analysis you have the option to use Stockfish 17.1 or your custom engine of choice, say if you want to use Leela or something. In Play mode, you will still go against my engine but I might make stockfish an option in the future too.[/p][p][b][u]Game Review[/u][/b][/p][p]This is similar to before but more improved. It should be a lot more reliable now.[/p][p]The review will use the engine you have currently chosen, either default or custom. Then you Run Review and wait for it to finish. After you will see the score graph and a count of inaccuracies and blunders.[/p][p]Icons will now be shown on the board, as well as in the log. You can disable this in the review section.[/p][p]Currently only inaccuracies and blunders are shown, as they are a lot simpler to implement.[/p][p][b]Full customisable blunders and inaccuracies[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964536/7a571eb925abff004a199c5c182bb9905b4aa7b9.png"][/img][/p][p]Instead of just hard coding the values, I tried to make them as customisable as possible: [/p][p]-Inaccuracies go from 0.3 to 1.5 points[/p][p]-Blunders go from 1 to 3.5 points[/p][p]So if you want it to be lenient and not nit-pick every possible drop in score, you can do that.[/p][p]And if you want it to criticise everything, like a masochist, then you can do that also.[/p][p][b]Still Winning Threshold[/b][/p][p]Another setting is the still winning threshold. This is basically for when it shouldn't matter if you play a slightly inaccurate move. This goes from 3, 4, 5, 6 or none.[/p][p]Basically how this works is that if you are winning by 5 points or more, then it generally doesn't matter if you didn't take a pawn or not. You're still winning if your score is above this threshold, so no blunders or inaccuracies will be marked. Set this to [b]none[/b] to turn this off.[/p][p][b][u]Manual Review[/u][/b][/p][p]This is an entirely new idea. As well as automated review, you can turn on the engine and have it save scores for each move you look at. Blunders and inaccuracies will then be highlighted automatically. The score will be saved in the log. This can also overwrite an automatic reviews score.[/p][p]Let's say that the engine said something was a blunder and you are doubtful, well you can simply turn on the engine and look at the position again. If the score was inaccurate, then the new score will overwrite it. You can turn this feature off in review settings too.[/p][p]If you want the counts and graph to be updated then simply click [b]Update Info[/b] after the manual review.[/p][p][b][u]Variations[/u][/b][/p][p]To create a variation, you simply play a move at any point except for on the last move played.[/p][p]Before I would insert variations into the same log section. This was honestly a complete nightmare to get working and caused a lot of headaches. Such as having to move every other element after the new along by one.[/p][p]I decided to remove that entirely and now I have a separate box for variations. The way this works is that each variation is linked to it's starting move. [/p][p]For example you create a variation from \[2.Nf3]. This variation will only be visible when that move is selected in the main window. If you click to another move, then those other variations will be shown instead, if they exist.[/p][p]I only allow one variation per main move and you can't stack them, for simplicity. If you play another move when not in the last position while there is already a variation for that base move, then the previous variation is cleared and the new takes its place.[/p][p][b]Still to do:[/b][/p][p]-Improve the default engine and make it support multiple principle variations, meaning show multiple best moves in a position.[/p][p]-Show best moves and only moves. Maybe brilliant moves too but that algorithm is far from simple.[/p][p]-When you make a new variation, it doesn't actually check if the next move was the same move. I plan to fix this in the future.[/p][p]-My long term goal is to have something that judges the complexity of a position based on the amount of good vs only moves available. Instead of just saying "Blunder!", it could say: "Blunder but there was only one good move." or instead: "Blunder! and there were many good options".[/p][p][/p][p][u][b]Fabiano Caruana game review:[/b][/u][/p][p]Added new commentary, moves to find and variations to Caruana's games.[/p][p]Before moves to find: 147[/p][p]Now moves to find: 306[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.31: 3D
notes.notes: [p]Chess Tools is now optionally 3D![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964536/f07ecf0da8fa0c8223a825ab5c9a3cce230658fd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Simply press 2d and 3d buttons to switch between them.[/p][p][/p][p]I thought I would maybe add this feature when I had nothing left to add but I did some experimenting and it wasn't too difficult to implement. What most publishers would do these days is create a completely different version of Chess Tools and call it Chess Tools 3d and charge way more for it. I'm not like that and want to give people as much value for money as possible. So this is just a free update, as they have all been.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964536/1218442f831a4bc33678839bb8b996a586317978.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Tools and everything still work as normal.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964536/6ac505d8d87380983817932053728bfe1025c246.jpg"][/img][/p][p]I also added a 1950s soviet style chess set.[/p][p][/p][p]There are 4 cameras angles in 3d mode, use Tab to cycle through them. There are also settings to turn off shadows or make the lighting more simple, if your computer isn't good enough but it's shouldn't be too graphically demanding.[/p][p][/p][p]On top of this:[/p][p][/p][p]Anand Game Review:[/p][p][/p][p]Went through all of Anand's game in Find the Move, added more explanations, variations and moves to find:[/p][p][/p][p]Total moves to find before: 140[/p][p]Total moves to find now: 324[/p][p][/p][p]Added more moves and commentary to Bobby Fischer vs Sofrevski:[/p][p]Before 3 moves, now 7.[/p][p][/p][p]Fixes:[/p][p]-Fixes an issue where the same puzzle could be chosen when doing 'any' puzzles. Now it's totally random and there are no duplicates.[/p][p][/p][p]Still left to do for this update:[/p][p]-Nakamura and Caruana game review[/p][p]-Alexander Alekhine's games[/p][p]-Emanual Lasker's games[/p]

notes.title: Plans for Update 1.2
notes.notes:
[b]Coming soon: Version 1.2: Opening Update[/b]

[b]Opening gambits:[/b]
Guides to many popular gambits such as: The Danish Gambit, The Stafford Gambit, The King's Gambit, The Vienna Gambit and more.

[b]More openings:[/b]
Guides to the Catalan Opening, The Grunfeld Defence and the Four Knights.

[b]Puzzles:[/b]
I will add a lot more puzzles, about 40 per category. It will also be randomised, so not the same puzzle order each time.
Categories:
Forks, discoveries, Openings, Defensive moves, Checkmate, Pins and a mixture

[b]Find the move notes:[/b]
I've had a suggestion to increase the number of moves to find in these famous games. The main reason sometimes some games don't have many moves to find is that I tried to pick positions where there is only one winning move.

It's a little unfair to have someone try to find one specific move in a position when they are three good options. Lots of move choices depend on style and player preference, so I tried to make sure that the move to find is the overall best move.

To try and increase the amount of moves to find, I will go through all of the games and see if there are any extra moves that I missed.

[b]Variant notes:[/b]
I've had other suggestions to add more variants. While it is relatively easy to code the rules for variants, what is not so easy is to create an engine that plays that variant well and without bugs. For every variant I add, I need to create a clone of the engine's algorithm and modify it with the new rules.

More variants are coming, but the time it takes will depend on how easy they are to implement with the new rules.

notes.title: Version 1.1: Modern GM Update - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Find The Move:[/b]
Add 80 more games:
20 games from [b]Magnus Carlsen[/b]
20 games from [b]Vishy Anand[/b]
20 games from [b]Hikaru Nakamura[/b]
20 games from [b]Fabiano Caruana[/b]

-Replaced the old button layout with a new preview for every game
-Menus will now save your previous scrolling position when going in and out of games

[b]Tutorials:[/b]
-Updated some tutorials
-Added 6 new tutorials:
   [i]Never Play f6[/i] - Should you really never play f3 or f6?
   [i]Tempo in Chess[/i] - the importance of time in Chess and how to gain it
   [i]Looking for better[/i] - When you find a good move, look for a better move
   [i]The Scotch Opening[/i] - A great opening for beginners to learn
   [i]The Caro-Kann opening[/i] - A solid opening defence for black
   [i]Theoretical Draws[/i] - Positions that are known to be draws.

-Menus will now remember your last scroll location when starting and ending tutorials

[b]General fixes / additions:[/b]
-Added a new light theme option that will make the background colours less dark and make menus more white. (90% of menus are compatible)

-Added a volume slider in settings

-Fixed menu collision in coordinate practice. Some buttons wouldn't be clickable from some positions due to text box overlapping.

-Fixed the way that underpromotion is handled with AI moves and importing PGNs.
Previously when you imported a game and, there was a promotion, a queen promotion was presumed. This would sometimes break further moves if there was an underpromotion. The ai could also not underpromote and it would autopromote to a queen. This is now fixed, the AI can now underpromote and underpromotions will work when reviewing and importing games.

notes.title: Small bug fixes
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

Tutorials:
Updated and Improved all opening tutorials
Fixed typos

Move Highlighter:
Fixed many bugs associated with this tool for example:
-If only an enemy king was defending a piece but two friendly piece were attacking it, it would be marked as a bad capture (red highlight). This will now show a good capture (green highlight).
-If only a pawn was defending then it would always be marked as a bad capture even it was attacked multiple times. Now it will show a good capture (green highlight)

White and black check tool:
Fixed a bug where a possible check would be shown when a pawn wasn't on its starting square but a check was being shown 2 moves away.

Import PGN:
Fixed a bug that would make some PGN imports not work. It was associated with how I didn't specify a white or black piece.

Improving and checking all other tutorials.
